snippet.title: Cité Alexandrie - Official Beta Release Date Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Don't miss the Beta Release Date Trailer for Cité Alexandrie, a VR city management game developed by Sirène Rouge Games. Players will manage the on-goings of a dystopian France after culture has been strictly forbidden. Smuggle cultural objects back into the city while evading the antagonistic CIB and rival gangs that stand in the way. Cité Alexandrie is launching into Beta on October 17 for Meta Quest.
